title: parse: missing_part uses (0,0) sentinel indistinguishable from real zero-offset range
description: missing_part() in parse.rs returns header_range=(0,0) and body_range=(0,0). A caller cannot distinguish a missing/placeholder part from a real part whose headers and body genuinely start at offset 0 with zero length. decode_body_value on a missing part returns empty string without error, silently hiding the parse failure. Trigger: mail-parser reports an out-of-range part index, yielding a missing_part node; callers using body_range to slice raw bytes get empty slice instead of an error.
